hero.description: An African energy group, ZENER develops fuel, gas, mobility and service solutions to sustainably support individuals, businesses and institutions.

presentation.badge: An African energy group on the move
presentation.text: ZENER develops and deploys energy solutions tailored to the realities of African markets. Through its activities in fuel, gas, lubricants, mobility and energy services, the Group supports individuals, professionals, businesses and institutions every day. Present in Togo, Benin and Guinea-Bissau, ZENER continues its regional growth, drawing on an in-depth understanding of its markets, dedicated infrastructure and a culture of usage-driven innovation.

expertise.subtitle: ZENER runs complementary businesses serving energy, mobility and related uses.
expertise.label: Our business lines

fuel.title: Fuel distribution
fuel.text: ZENER distributes fuel through a structured network of stations and infrastructure meeting international safety and quality standards.

gas.title: Gas / energy
gas.text: ZENER develops safe and accessible gas and household energy solutions, tailored to the needs of households and local businesses.

mobility.title: Mobility & services
mobility.text: ZENER designs integrated mobility services to support travel, professional uses and the new expectations of users.

lubricants.title: Lubricants
lubricants.text: ZENER offers a range of lubricants and accessories selected to ensure the performance, durability and protection of equipment.

business.title: B2B solutions
business.text: ZENER supports businesses and institutions with energy solutions and B2B services designed to meet complex operational needs.

banner.title: Oasis, the Zener station network
banner.text: Oasis brings together ZENER stations: fuel, neighborhood services and a welcome designed for everyday journeys as well as fleets. A place to relax and access services across the country.

quality.title: Governance and ethics
quality.text: Rigorous standards of ethics, transparency and compliance, for a safe, dynamic and responsible company.

security.title: Raising awareness for greater safety
security.text: A safety awareness program on the use of LPG and fuel, to promote good practices and reduce risks.

responsibility.title: Protecting the environment
